eval.title: Dollar General Stock A Buy Now Below Long Term Trend (DG Stock)

call.headline_quote: Dollar General stock looks like a strong relative buy at the moment

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: the cash flows are still there especially when you compare the cash flows to the market cap that's now a 10% yield plus the growth that's more than 10%

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: then we have a 10 11 12% return here which puts it into the buy side of our risk and reward value investment quadrant

what_is_priced_in.quote: the market is saying the Dollar General and small box value model is simply structural challenged or broken

reasons.claim: Cash flow relative to market cap now gives roughly a 10% yield plus growth, implying over 10% expected returns.
reasons.quote: the cash flows are still there especially when you compare the cash flows to the market cap that's now a 10% yield plus the growth that's more than 10%

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.1, as-of 0.0411549 (FY2024); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Wall Street was bullish when the stock was high and bearish now that it's low, which is the opposite of how value investors should act, so the sell-off is overdone.
reasons.quote: when the stock price is high and there is exuberance they are repurchasing Common Stocks... when the stock price was extremely high exuberant everyone was considering it a buy now most of Wall Street tells you it's a sell

reasons.claim: The business model is not structurally broken since new stores remain profitable and cash flow from operations is strong, despite Wall Street's narrative.
reasons.quote: there are challenges but not on the model because everything is working new stores are still profitable

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: cash from operations growth

reasons.claim: Gross margin compression from around 31-32% to just above 30% has cut net income margin roughly in half, from 7% to 4%, hurting near-term earnings.
reasons.quote: gross margins go from 31 32 to just a little bit above 30 so nothing but that has a huge repercussions on net income margins from 7% to 4%

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.07, as-of -0.144691 (FY2024); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: A well-known value investor (Seth Klarman) has bought into Dollar General for its long-term cash flows, supporting the stability thesis.
reasons.quote: set claran the Great Value investor has also started a position in Dollar General for the likely long-term cash flows that we will discuss

external_facts_used: Seth Klarman has started a position in Dollar General
Wall Street analyst target price history (from 270 target at $250 price, not yet adjusted below $100)
conference call commentary on customer paycheck timing pressures
